messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — bringup for r3b-compact-int8 on web-sampled rerank eval looks off. NDCG@10 down ~4.5% vs prod-ctrl, but MRR is slightly up. Suspect candidate doc noise (urls/casing/html).
raj: can you paste a couple of failing examples?
emma: yep, pasted a couple below. notice the candidate text has raw urls and inconsistent caps.
```
Q: how to reset password
cand1: "To reset, go to https://support.example.com/reset and follow steps."
cand2: "To Reset Password: Open Settings > Account > Reset"
```
sam: interesting — our prod preproc lowercases + strips simple urls, right? which eval pipeline did you run (raw vs canonicalized)?
emma: ran against eval-harness v2 default (raw text). prod-ctrl used canonicalizer v1 (lowercase + url-strip). I re-ran quick diff with lowercase+strip and numbers look better.
tess: can you share the numbers? even roughs help triage.
emma: baseline(prod-ctrl): NDCG@10=0.412, MRR=0.276. r3b-int8 raw: NDCG@10=0.394, MRR=0.281. r3b-int8 normalized (lower+strip): NDCG@10=0.408, MRR=0.279.
raj: so most regression is from formatting mismatch (not quantization per-se). still ~0.004 gap left — could be truncation or candidate ordering changes. can you run an ablation that keeps original canonicalizer but forces the same candidate sort as baseline?
emma: will do. creating CI job: rerank-ci/r3b-int8-format-ablation now. @ci-bot can you run that on the full web-sample (10k queries) with the following flags: --canonicalize=textnorm_v1 --force-sort=prod-order --report=ndcg,mrr,delta?
ci-bot: Job rerank-ci/r3b-int8-format-ablation queued (executor: short). link: https://ci.internal/rerank/1765432109
tess: quick note — also check seqlen distribution; int8 kvpack behavior sometimes hurts very long docs after truncation. add --seqlen-hist to job.
sam: also log candidate text diffs for top-3 mismatches; sometimes url tokens shift embed scale.
emma: good calls — updated job flags. will post results in this thread. planning triage: 1) confirm format parity (this CI run), 2) check truncation / kvpack for long docs, 3) if still gap, run int8 vs fp16 per-candidate score scatter.
raj: sounds good. assign sam to candidate-diff logging, tess to seqlen/kvpack check, emma to run the CI and collate. i'll follow up with a short doc summarizing cause+fix once we have numbers. :thumbsup:
